rv.q: Through Bollywood moments, choreographed routines and poignant conversation, the play uses wit, set design and style in a way that not only provokes conversation but actively participates in it.

Explores dimensions in culture, inclusion and belonging; passion, perceptions and prejudgements. is a testament to the reflective, insightful writing of Mohit Mathur. Performing with Sharan Phull , Mathur explores themes of South Asian culture and belonging.
